Combo Kit (5.0Ah) - Distributed/Packaged by Makita. Product Details: The LXT 18V Brushless 2-Piece Combo Kit (XT296ST) offers two premium brushless tools for drilling, driving and clamping. The kit includes two 18V LXT 5.0Ah fast charging batteries, compatible with the entire range of Makita tools and products.The kit includes an 18V LXT Brushless 4-Speed Impact Driver (XDT14Z), combining power and speed in a compact size. The XDT14 offers 1.55 in. lbs. of maximum torque and weighs only 1.5 kg. Featuring a 5.0Ah battery, with a 3-speed power selection switch (0-1,100 / 0-2,100 / 0-3,600 RPM and 0-1,100 / 0-2,600 / 0-3,800 IPM) and Makita exclusive Quick-Shift Mode for greater clamping control. Quick-Shift mode uses the electronic brushless motor controls to find the best balance of speed and torque for each application for more efficient attachment. Another precision setting is tightening mode (T mode), which switches low and reduces rotation and impact speed before driving the screw into place, and is designed to minimize stripping of screw threads, screw breakage, and damage to work.The LXT 18V Brushless Variable Hammer Driver Drill (XPH16Z) combines power and runtime for more drilling, driving and fixing tasks in wood, metal and masonry. Delivers up to 1,800 RPM and a total of 970 inches. lbs. of maximum torque for up to and weighs only 5 lbs. with a 5.0Ah battery.Both tools feature an efficient Makita built brushless motor for longer run time, increased power and speed, and longer tool life. Extreme Protection Technology (XPT) provides better dust and water resistance for operation in harsh conditions.Both tools are part of Makita's expanding 18V LXT system, the world's largest cordless tool system powered by 18V lithium-ion slide-style batteries. Makita 18V LXT lithium-ion batteries have the fastest charging times in their categories, so they spend more time working and less time sitting on the charger.To improve tool performance and extend battery life, Makita created Star Protection Computer Controls. Star Protection is a communication technology that allows the Star Protection-equipped tool and battery to exchange data in real time and monitor conditions during use to protect against overcharging, over-discharging and overheating. For added versatility, the tool can also be powered by 18V LXT and Compact Lithium-Ion batteries with the star symbol on the battery indicating Star Protection inside.
